context.content: Basically, if you have a company, even if you don't make a lot of money, you kinda need a business account. Has to do with rules regarding money laundering and economic sanctions of certain countries. So yeah, just part of being self-employed here. I'm self-employed as well, my business account is at ASN, and they were very interested in the fact that I could get money from Russia, they also had some questions about that. But any bank needs to ask those questions.
